name: eBay Graphics/Video Cards, used Intel Arc B580 asking prices
notes: Live SRP capture read 2026-10-03. The used B580 market on eBay is THIN: only 13 genuine B580 12GB cards in the used result set, and eBay's own price histogram puts 7 of them in the $300-400 band, 4 in $400-500, 1 at $250-300. Price buckets: under $240 / $240-$280 / over $280. That is a used price at or slightly above the new price - see the Newegg Refreshed record for the refurb channel, which sits materially lower.
